location_hint: Honolulu, Hawaii. Warm climate all year, no real winter. Many customers enjoy light, refreshing dishes.

special_messages: Because Hawaii is warm all year, avoid recommending heavy hot stews unless the customer explicitly asks.
When in doubt, suggest refreshing dishes with seafood and fresh vegetables.
If the label looks like a local Hawaiian product, gently mention one local-style pairing as an option.
